visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long hair wearing a light blue lace dress is standing in a white-walled studio next to a man with glasses and a striped shirt. She introduces him with energetic hand gestures while they both smile at the camera. The setting is clean and well-lit. (2) The scene cuts to the man seated at a brown grand piano. Multiple camera angles are used, including a side-view medium shot showing his posture and an overhead top-down shot focusing on his fingers moving with high speed and precision across the piano keys. (3) The pianist performs three distinct musical passages. The visual focus remains on the intricate movements of his hands and his concentrated facial expressions. Text overlays appear at the bottom and top of the frame to provide context for the pieces. (4) The woman returns to the screen, clapping enthusiastically and high-fiving the man. They are positioned next to the piano in a medium full shot. The woman points toward the camera while talking. (5) A graphic poster for a concert titled '山海迴響' is displayed, followed by the two individuals waving goodbye to the camera in a friendly manner.
